title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Workspaces updates for shared team work
summary: The automatic notebook conversion, roadmap targets, licensing quotations and documented policy routes are supported. The briefing correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting storage and licensing guidance; its redirect statement needs Microsoft's qualification that redirects apply when applicable.
